# I declare catalog1; this declaration alone grants no host authority.
service "nsi:nanolang/filesystem" catalog 1 from "interface.nsi.json"

shadow temp {
    let opened: OpenResult = (temp)
    match opened {
        Ok(file) => {
            let mut owned: File = file
            let closed: CloseResult = (close owned)
            match closed {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
        }
        Error(error) => { assert false }
    }
}

shadow write_byte {
    let opened: OpenResult = (temp)
    match opened {
        Ok(file) => {
            let mut owned: File = file
            let zero: WriteResult = (write_byte &mut owned 0)
            match zero {
                Ok(count) => { assert (== count 1) }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let written: WriteResult = (write_byte &mut owned 255)
            match written {
                Ok(count) => { assert (== count 1) }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let closed: CloseResult = (close owned)
            match closed {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
        }
        Error(error) => { assert false }
    }
}

shadow rewind {
    let opened: OpenResult = (temp)
    match opened {
        Ok(file) => {
            let mut owned: File = file
            let written: WriteResult = (write_byte &mut owned 255)
            match written {
                Ok(count) => { assert (== count 1) }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let positioned: PositionResult = (rewind &mut owned)
            match positioned {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let read: ReadResult = (read_byte &mut owned)
            match read {
                Ok(byte) => {
                    assert (== byte.value 255)
                    assert (not byte.eof)
                }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let closed: CloseResult = (close owned)
            match closed {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
        }
        Error(error) => { assert false }
    }
}

shadow read_byte {
    let opened: OpenResult = (temp)
    match opened {
        Ok(file) => {
            let mut owned: File = file
            let written: WriteResult = (write_byte &mut owned 0)
            match written {
                Ok(count) => { assert (== count 1) }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let positioned: PositionResult = (rewind &mut owned)
            match positioned {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let read: ReadResult = (read_byte &mut owned)
            match read {
                Ok(byte) => {
                    assert (== byte.value 0)
                    assert (not byte.eof)
                }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let ended: ReadResult = (read_byte &mut owned)
            match ended {
                Ok(byte) => { assert byte.eof assert (== byte.value 0) }
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
            let closed: CloseResult = (close owned)
            match closed {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
        }
        Error(error) => { assert false }
    }
}

shadow close {
    let opened: OpenResult = (temp)
    match opened {
        Ok(file) => {
            let mut owned: File = file
            let closed: CloseResult = (close owned)
            match closed {
                Ok() => {}
                Error(error) => { assert false }
            }
        }
        Error(error) => { assert false }
    }
}
